preconditions: test-bus I2C electrically isolated from analogue mux I2C pins
separate high impedance sniff GPIOs connected to test-bus SCL/SDA
fresh healthy baseline for each recovery candidate

current.purpose: valid baseline ID read of register 0x20; device ID high byte 0x41
probe unrelated EDID address 0x50, capture waveform then verify ID
full 0x08..0x77 address sweep INCLUDING MCP9601; verify ID
record SDA/SCL idle line levels after ID read failure
teardown/rebuild ESP-IDF master peripheral; then ID
forced START/STOP-like GPIO transitions without complete SCL pulse; then ID
one SCL pulse followed by STOP; then ID
nine SCL pulses followed by STOP; then ID
eighteen SCL pulses followed by STOP; then ID
ordinary controller-generated probe + STOP; then ID

future.purpose: compare controller reset, CP construction STOP and captured bit patterns
detect controller/kernel limits and test legal transactions through /dev/i2c
regression: second sensor works before/after recovery; register state unchanged

classification.confirmed_failure: MCP9601 ID read worked initially, then fails after trigger without VDD interruption
classification.high_high_unresponsive: confirmed_failure AND physical SDA=HIGH AND SCL=HIGH after transfer
classification.recovered: a valid 0x41xx ID read succeeds after exactly one intervention
classification.no_recovery: ID still fails after selected intervention
classification.inconclusive: baseline unverified, missing waveforms, other master active, or lost RMT samples

capture.format: human-readable RMT pulse duration lines; independent time axes
limitations: RMT RX starts on first line transition, per-channel alignment not established
buffer overrun possible on full scans
idle-high pin levels are observations, not device communication proof
